title: AssetBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Envelope for a batch of INTELLIGENT Assets (int:Asset and its subclasses), all belonging to the same Facility and/or Site. Every asset subtype inherits all base Asset fields (assetId, ownedBy, assetName, assetType, validFrom, validUntil, isControllable, commissioningDate, manufacturer, model, serialNumber, nominalPower, protocol). AssetState and AssetMeasurement fields (operational state and time-series readings) are out of scope for this schema and are covered by the separate AssetState and AssetMeasurement EWDS Topic schemas.

facilityId.description: FK to the Facility that all Assets in this batch are installed at. At least one of facilityId or siteId is required.

siteId.description: FK to the Site that all Assets in this batch are located at. At least one of facilityId or siteId is required.

items.title: BatteryUnit
items.description: int:BatteryUnit (renamed from Battery, cim:BatteryUnit / IEC 61850 ZBAT). Represents an electrical energy storage system (BESS). Inherits all base Asset fields. Excludes AssetState/AssetMeasurement fields, which belong to the separate AssetState/AssetMeasurement EWDS Topic schemas.

ownedBy.description: FK to the owning Member, via Actor class.

assetType.description: Controlled AssetType enumeration value. Fixed per array (see const on each subtype).

validFrom.description: Start of the asset's validity/installation period. ISO 8601 with timezone.

validUntil.description: End of the asset's validity period, ISO 8601 with timezone. Omit if still active.

isControllable.description: True if the asset exposes an actuator interface. Actual control state is handled by ControlAssetCommand, not this field.

commissioningDate.description: Date the asset was commissioned, YYYY-MM-DD. Maps to CIM Asset.lifecycle.installationDate.

manufacturer.description: Asset manufacturer name. Maps to CIM Asset.AssetInfo.manufacturer.

model.description: Asset model/product name. Maps to CIM Asset.AssetInfo.catalogAssetType.

serialNumber.description: Manufacturer serial number. Maps to CIM Asset.serialNumber.

nominalPower.description: Rated/nominal active power capacity, in W. Required by IEC CIM for any PowerSystemResource; overridden with more specific capacity fields in subclasses where applicable.

protocol.description: Communication protocol used by the asset. Required when isControllable is true.

pInBatMax.description: Maximum charge power rating, in W. Must be > 0 and <= nominalPower. Maps to ZBAT.MaxChaRte.

pOutBatMax.description: Maximum discharge power rating, in W. Must be > 0 and <= nominalPower. Maps to ZBAT.MaxDsRte.

ratedE.description: Rated energy storage capacity, in kWh. Mandatory CIM field for BatteryUnit.

batteryTechnology.description: Battery chemistry/technology, from D2.1 pilot data.

socMin.description: Minimum allowable state of charge, percentage (0-100). Must be less than socMax.

socMax.description: Maximum allowable state of charge, percentage (0-100). Must be greater than socMin.
